audit: NASA EGIS New Orleans Louisiana flood BWTR fixed-area coverage diagnostic

export_design.sample_unit: all raster grid cells returned over the registered bbox; not the product's native UTM grid

interpretation: The catalog item footprint intersects the registered New Orleans box, but the locked BWTR export returned no valid 0/1 classifications on the requested approximately 30 m EPSG:3857 grid; the city-centre identify request also returned NoData. This is missing product coverage, not evidence that the area was dry or that no flooding occurred.
limits: The public response map is preliminary and unvalidated; it is not independent flood truth.
The catalog item name encodes a June 21–27 acquisition interval, not a per-pixel acquisition timestamp.
The interval is not demonstrably event-time matched to the City's June 18 report under the protocol's 24-hour primary rule.
One missing-data screen does not establish adequate temporal sampling, classification accuracy, asset exposure, or confirmatory eligibility.
No additional result is generalized from this single event or site.

source.independent_event_record_summary: City of New Orleans reported flash flooding and a continuing flood watch in its June 18, 2026 update.
source.source_caveat: NASA service describes rapid-response maps as preliminary and unvalidated.
